test_case.test_name: ADDDC second bank-VLS allocation on different device and bank
test_case.purpose: Prove a threshold on a different device and different bank preserves the existing bank VLS and adds the BIOS-approved second bank region.
required_package: Proof dev0=1/bank1 differs on both axes
Dedicated SUT, SMM timeout, OOB recovery and rollback
test_case.test_command: Qualified operator verifies predecessor geometry, proves the new target differs by device and bank, applies mask0x3 and exactly two CEs, confirms threshold, executes go once, optionally samples copy, verifies first region unchanged, approved second region present and counter cleared, then restores settings and validates health.
test_case.expected_result: Threshold is reached at the two-axis-different target; original region remains, the exact second bank region is allocated, bookkeeping clears and the SUT stays healthy.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires exact predecessor/new geometry, two CEs, threshold, preserved first plus approved second region, counter clear and restoration. Rank promotion, first-region loss, wrong buddy, missing clear or instability fails/blocks.
safety_gate: Critical injection approval on isolated SUT.
Reject changed predecessor or unproven two-axis mapping.
Exactly two CEs; stop on wrong first-event target/severity.
No retry to chase transient copy state or consume more spares.
expected_evidence: Two-axis target proof and two CE transcripts
Threshold state and optional copy sample
Before/after region table plus counter clear
test_case.recovery: On wrong allocation, first-region mutation or hang, preserve state and use approved OOB recovery without extra injection; restore ADDDC/threshold settings and verify memory topology/spare state.
